correctness.rationale: H decreases strictly from r to 0 on (0,K) when qK<=1, including qK=1 away from x=0. At a prey-only equilibrium f_x=xH'/(1+qx)<0, and the other eigenvalue is G. Its numerator is -vBx²+(A-v-dB)x-d; there is a positive interval iff the quadratic has two distinct positive roots, equivalently A>(sqrt(v)+sqrt(dB))². Intersecting (x_-,x_+) with (0,K) and applying the decreasing H gives every stated root/capacity case, with the equality cases excluded from strict invasion. At in-range simple thresholds, solve f=0 as x=phi(y,h) with phi(0,h)=x_h and phi_y=-R. The positive equilibrium relation G(phi)-my=0 then has y-derivative Q=-m-G'R and h-derivative lambda'=G'/H'. When Q!=0, IFT gives slope -lambda'/Q. On the positive branch the dynamical Jacobian has negative trace sufficiently near collision and determinant y f_x[-m-G'(x)f_y/f_x]; thus Q>0 makes a saddle and Q<0 a sink. At x_+, lambda'>0 and Q=m_crit-m; at x_-, lambda'<0 and Q<0. This proves the branch-side and stability claims without relying on a numerical center manifold. The example gives exact H(3)=26/25, H(1)=44/25, m_crit=299/5500 and slopes -125/61 and -125/118, with nearby finite-state determinant signs independently checked.
residual_risks: The claim concerns the classical autonomous ODE, strictly positive invasion exponents and nearby branches at simple in-range thresholds. A zero exponent alone does not classify nonlinear stability. Degenerate equality m=m_crit and global replacement, persistence or extinction are not settled.

Govindan–Singh model equations and local stability condition C5
value.rationale: Harvesting a prey can improve rare-predator growth by lowering prey counterattack and then make growth worse by limiting food. The exact capacity and harvest thresholds distinguish that regime from monotone or absent invasion. Even on the non-invasion side of the lower threshold, weak predator self-limitation allows a nearby positive saddle, while the upper threshold cannot have that backward entry in this model. This makes the cutoff useful for interpreting equilibrium diagrams rather than a mere reformulation of the invasion eigenvalue.
residual_risks: The local saddle does not establish bistability between two attractors, a global hysteresis loop or management advice. The classification is not asserted for fractional memory dynamics.
